description: Primary key of this table: one row per order, exactly 99,441 rows.
gotcha: Unique in this table. In the raw data it is also unique.

description: The customer identifier the order was placed under.
gotcha: NOT a person: 2,997 identifiers belong to more than one customer_id.

description: The person behind the customer_id. Count PEOPLE with this column.
gotcha: Pseudonymous identifier inherited from the source (a hash). No names, emails, addresses or phone numbers are included in this dataset.

description: Brazilian state (2-letter code) of the customer's address.
Status of the order: delivered, shipped, canceled, unavailable, invoiced, processing, created, approved.
gotcha: 96,478 orders say 'delivered' but only 96,476 carry a delivery date.

description: Calendar month of the purchase, e.g. 2017-10. Use it for monthly time series.
gotcha: Derived from the purchase timestamp, not from the delivery date.

description: True when the order actually arrived (a real delivery date exists).
gotcha: This is a FACT about the data, not the same as order_status == 'delivered' (8 orders differ).

description: Days between the promised delivery date and the real delivery. Negative = arrived EARLY than promised.
gotcha: NaN for the 2,965 orders that were never delivered - do NOT fillna(0), that would fake 'delivered exactly on time'.

description: Number of distinct order items in the order.
gotcha: The raw items table has NO duplicate rows at all (measured: 0).

description: Number of distinct sellers in the order.
Sum of the item prices (before freight).
gotcha: Total item value, NOT the revenue actually collected.

description: Number of distinct payment records for the order.
gotcha: 2,961 orders have more than one payment row (max 29). This is what makes a naive merge fan out.

description: Total amount actually paid for the order. THIS is the revenue number.
gotcha: Differs from items_price_sum + items_freight_sum by 165,318.88 in total; the two are not supposed to be identical.

description: Payment methods used, sorted and joined with '|', e.g. 'credit_card|voucher'.
gotcha: Split on '|' if you need one row per method.

description: The customer's review score, 1-5. NaN when the order has no review.
gotcha: Collapsed BY ORDER (highest score kept), never by review_id: 789 review_ids appear on different orders and deduping by review_id would delete 545 orders' reviews entirely.
